manual_joins.prepare: C=&A[0x360], K=B+0x358, t=WORD[W+2*k]; count=((WORD[C+0x12]-WORD[C+0x14]+8*t) mod 65536)>>3; zero returns with local stores only
manual_joins.prepare_one: One item, marker checks valid, metadata-cache hit, successful lock, matching drain object/key/shard, incremented ten-bit header field neither class-table value nor 1, counter post-subtraction sign clear; toggle bitmap, increment header by 2^28, drain C+8, update shard stats, set C+0x12=low16(end-8*t)
manual_joins.wrapper: D=[K]; request=t>>(BYTE[D+k+0x34]&31); call worker(B,E,C,&W[k],k,request); BYTE[D+k+0x58]=1; pop using two low16 bounds; status 1 can accompany Q=0
manual_joins.worker_one: One requested item, existing head with nonzero ten-bit header field and first bitmap word nonzero; clear its lowest set bit, write base+bit*stride at end-8, subtract 2^28 from the header, drain C+8, update shard stats, set C=end-8, decrement DWORD[B+0x98]
manual_joins.worker_zero: Still lock/unlock, update shard visit/drain stats, clear C+8, store cursor=end and decrement DWORD[B+0x98]; no bitmap/pointer-array write
manual_joins.direct_one: Zero-table caller -> existing-head direct allocation; first bitmap word nonzero; toggle lowest set bit, decrement header by 2^28, return base+bit*stride nonzero; update shard stats and decrement B+0x98; R8D=0 skips memset
manual_joins.caller: Wrapper status1 increments C+8 before Q null test; status0 goes directly to errno12. Direct alternative has no cache count increment. Nonnull results join earlier accounting mode1.
